{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute response rates stratified by severity
stratified_rates = trial_df.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(level='severity')

# Compute the treatment effect within each severity stratum
stratified_effect = stratified_rates['treatment'] - stratified_rates['control']

# Display stratified response rates and effects
stratified_rates, stratified_effect"}
